source_offset.description: Overview refresh only: selected-source page offset, default 0. Follow source_page.next_offset until null before staging. Cannot combine with source_ids.

candidates.description: Native JSON array of new candidate objects; never a JSON string. No operation_key/base_profile_revision wrapper inside this array.

base_profile_revision.description: Copy context.snapshot_revision as an integer; outer tool field, not inside candidates.

operation_key.description: Copy the exact stable operation_key from the workflow input; outer tool field, never inside a candidate.

summary.description: Natural summary of supported current patient details, retaining uncertainty and corrections. Does not replace exact candidate evidence or assert medical verification.

record_source_refs.description: Natural record only: select currently valid authorized indexed_sentences. Send candidates:[] and nonempty record_dialogue.summary; optional health_observations must be exact snippets supported by the selected sentence. Server derives exact complete-sentence evidence. Never mix with manual candidates.

summary.description: 1–3 brief sentences assessing recent overall circumstances. Preserve attribution, dates, uncertainty and reported changes. Never list the whole original text, processing metadata, diagnoses, health scores or treatment changes.

problems.description: Complete replacement document. Reuse prior stable keys. Retain all active/improving/uncertain previous problems with valid sources, including unrelated complaints not mentioned this turn.

key.description: Stable problem-event key, reused from previous document.

status.description: Follow-up state, never severity or evidence type. Use evidence_status dimension for source attribution.

assessment.description: Brief sourced explanation of present state, supported change from prior assessment and remaining unknowns. No diagnosis or risk exclusion.

dimensions.description: Eight concise independent syntheses; unknown=null means unrecorded, never normal/absent. Preserve temporal range of denials, self-rating attribution, measurement units/original dates, document judgment attribution, and planned versus reported executed treatment. Do not copy the full history into each dimension.

document_source_refs.description: Document extraction: select authorized indexed_sentences and classify each sentence with field. Use candidates:[]; never mix nonempty record_source_refs or manual candidates. Exact complete evidence and literal annotations are reconstructed and strictly validated by the server. Provide a native overview object.

candidate.description: All evidence quotes must exactly equal this candidate value; field/assertion/temporal_scope/effective_time are validated solely against that rendered value. Unrelated auxiliary evidence is rejected.

health_observation.description: Extractive metadata supported by this candidate sentence only. value, unit and observed_at must be exact supported snippets, preserving negation and uncertainty. No inferred scores, units, dates or diagnoses. Missing unit/time is omitted or null; recorded time is not event time.

comparison.description: Compare against a currently confirmed same-owner fact actually retrieved in this run. candidate_index is the zero-based original candidates or record_source_refs or document_source_refs index. Explicit temporal change is update; simultaneous incompatible claims are conflict. Comparisons never replace facts automatically.

healththread_stage_candidates.description: Call with a native outer object: candidates is a native array, base_profile_revision is an outer integer copied from context.snapshot_revision, operation_key is the exact outer business key supplied for this run. Do not JSON.stringify candidates or put top-level metadata inside candidates.

claim.description: Every submitted source quote and fact value must equal the evidence claim text. Granular claims are optional for v2 chat and visit; the server preserves authorized source links. V2 visible reply or visit speech is a separate natural synthesis. Legacy visit evidence requirements remain unchanged.

claims.description: For format_version:2 default to []; authorized source links are server-owned. Optional granular claims still require exact source evidence. Do not drop format_version during repairs.

format_version.description: Natural patient-facing format. Omit for legacy payloads.

explanation.description: Optional model paraphrase of referenced confirmed instructions, displayed separately from exact text. Preserve dose, frequency, timing and uncertainty; no unsupported quantities, actions or medication changes.

questions.description: Questions to clarify missing or ambiguous source details; never turn unknown medicine, dose or timing into advice.

care_task.description: Every instruction_ref must have exactly this task text. All distinct confirmed instruction texts must be represented; identical instruction texts may share one task with their corresponding references.

speech.description: Legacy visible speech. Optional for format_version:2 chat; omission is stored as an empty string.

unknowns.description: Optional for format_version:2 chat; omission is stored as an empty list. Supplied values retain the same validation.

intent.description: offer_* means the assistant is asking the user for execution permission. Asking for permission always uses offer_*, never confirm_*. confirm_* means the current user explicitly authorized execution of a matching still-pending prior offer. If pending_action_offer is absent/null, use offer_* for an action request. Refused, deferred or superseded offers cannot authorize execution. Interpret meaning, not keywords such as confirm or yes.

format_version.description: Natural patient-facing format. Omit for legacy payloads.

reply.description: The complete natural assistant turn, including any focused questions. Evidence metadata is not the visible reply.

confirmation_quote.description: Only for confirm_*: exact full current user text explicitly granting execution permission for the current pending_action_offer. Asking the assistant to confirm or agreeing with a symptom summary is not execution consent. Omit for offer_*.

confirmation_offer_id.description: Only for confirm_*: copy the existing matching pending_action_offer.run_id exactly. Never invent an id or use an empty string. If no pending offer exists, choose offer_* and omit all confirmation fields; do not recover a refused or expired offer from history.

confirmation_has_new_details.description: False only when the consenting user turn contains no new health details or corrections; omitted means retain the source.
